correctness.rationale: Use differences d_k and monotone cumulative tails T_i(k) to obtain a nonnegative difference matrix a; its ℓ1 norm gives β=max_k(T_n(k)−T_1(k)). Any row-pair signed measure is the discrete derivative of c_0=c_n=0 with 0≤c_k≤β; maximizing half ℓ1 oscillation over the β-cube has at most floor(n/2) positive blocks, so δ≤floor(n/2)β. Endpoint rows imply δ≥β; interlaced odd/even rows mixed with uniform noise yield strictly positive sharp upper cases; (1−ε)I+εJ yields lower equality. β=0 and n=2,3 boundaries explicit.
